final_candidates.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices 1.1
final_candidates.provider: W3C Web Accessibility Initiative, Protocols & Formats Working Group
final_candidates.product_feature: Tab control, active selection and corresponding visible panel
final_candidates.version_or_date: Dated 2015-05-14 Working Draft; exact publication time unknown.
final_candidates.exact_section: 2.31 Tab Panel; returned lines 1046–1084; document-status limitations at lines 4–21
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Activating a tab selects it and reveals its associated panel; initialization supplies an active tab and keyboard movement can change it.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Separates missing tab controls from existing controls whose selected panel is hidden or mismatched. The supplied report does not distinguish those states.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Inspect the selection-to-panel relationship as a diagnostic invariant rather than treating an opened outer pane as proof that its editable contents initialized.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed T2: in the failing pane, inspect whether the Properties selector exists, which tab is selected, and whether its associated panel is visible; activate that selector if it exists and compare the resulting state.
final_candidates.expected_output: An existing selected Properties control with a hidden/missing associated panel localizes a selection/display mismatch. No Properties control points to an earlier creation/visibility stage. These are proposed classifications, not observed results.
final_candidates.conditions_supported: The request already involves a tabbed editing pane; the guidance supplies a general relationship to inspect without adding a new user requirement.
final_candidates.limitations: Node-RED's ARIA markup and keyboard implementation were not verified. This is web UI component guidance, not cross-domain novelty or a Node-RED-specific fix.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: The document is a non-final draft and explicitly marks this section as carried forward from APG 1.0 pending review.
final_candidates.historical_availability: The official dated edition is from 2015, before the supplied 2024-01-01 report; actual prior use by the author is unknown.
